info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Current Account Retrieval API
info.description: The Corporate Current Account Retrieval API enables businesses to access detailed information about specific corporate current accounts. This endpoint supports queries for balances, transactions, and account details, thereby facilitating financial management for corporate clients. Financial institutions, accounting systems, and corporate finance teams are typical consumers of this functionality, aiming to streamline account tracking and reporting. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure effective cash flow management and informed decision-making regarding their financial resources.

get.summary: Retrieve corporate current account details by ID.
get.description: Fetch the specific details of a corporate current account using its unique identifier. This operation allows users to view account information such as balance, transaction history, and account status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch information related to the corporate current account identified by ACC-200045. The request retrieves account-specific operations and related data in a structured JSON format. Proper authorization and valid account credentials are required to access this endpoint.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the corporate current account details.
